plan: Implement a workflow-dispatch-only, GET-only App Store Connect evidence collector fixed to PlanFlow 1.0.0 Build 17.
Query and validate the canonical app/build, beta feedback crash submissions, crash logs, and Apple diagnostic signatures.
Write only an allowlisted PII-safe JSON report and a bounded GitHub summary; preserve no raw provider payload.
Add deterministic fixture tests for build binding, pagination, sanitization, parsing, and HTTP-method restrictions.
Run focused validation, independent final-diff review, and integration; commit and non-force push only owned files.
Keep Build 18 blocked. If the workflow cannot be dispatched here, request exactly one user action to run it.

planner.result: ROOT_CAUSE_NOT_IDENTIFIED and Build18 blocked. Implement a separate, manually dispatched, GET-only ASC collector with strict build binding and PII-safe output; do not touch release/native/Android files.

complex_implementer.assignment: Implement the isolated workflow-dispatch-only, GET-only App Store Connect Build 17 crash-evidence collector, PII-safe output, and deterministic contract tests.
complex_implementer.result: Created the three-file collector/workflow/test implementation. Rework aligned Build.attributes.version with build 17 and preReleaseVersion 1.0.0/IOS, normalized absolute pagination links, parsed beta crash logs and official diagnostic log schemas, and separated beta-crash from launch/hang/disk-write diagnostics. Final integration hardening added concatenated multi-line JSON .ips decoding and fail-closed handling for unparseable crash logs. Review cycle 2 added strict JSON:API resource/relationship validation, allowlist sanitizers, bounded crash/diagnostic output with truncation markers, collector-step-only secrets, trusted exact-main-SHA checkout, and mocked HTTP/schema/size security tests. Review cycle 3 validated every relationship linkage, required structurally complete JSON or classic crash logs, removed provider request IDs from output, and made verified credential cleanup part of the final fail-closed gate. Review cycle 4 replaced generic provider-text handling with field-specific canonical allowlists, rejected IP/MAC/IPv6 and identifier/token classes, bound diagnostic signature relationships to canonical Build 17, and required at least one valid diagnostic log before diagnostic evidence can PASS. Review cycle 5 blocked semantic PII/secret/credential/API-key/provider-token classes across symbols, binaries, and signatures, and rejected any concatenated crash payload containing a non-object JSON document. Review cycle 6 generalized Stripe-style sk/pk/rk prefixes across environments and broadened GitHub, Slack, Google, and AWS provider-prefix blocking with full serialized-output tests. Review cycle 7 replaced permissive arbitrary bare symbol/binary/signature acceptance with positive program-shape, runtime, system, and known-dependency namespace allowlists while preserving deliberate Runner/App.framework crash evidence.
